definitions.oracle: minimum of forced Lightweight and Hybrid means; ties are optimal for either choice
definitions.dangerous: Auto selects Lightweight and Hybrid is strictly faster
definitions.conservative: Auto selects Hybrid and Lightweight is strictly faster
definitions.material: dangerous and (absolute regret > 1 ms or relative regret > 20 percent)
definitions.severe: dangerous and (absolute regret > 5 ms or Lightweight > 1.5x Hybrid)
definitions.catastrophic: dangerous and (absolute regret > 10 ms or Lightweight > 2x Hybrid)
definitions.near_tie: absolute gap < 0.25 ms or relative gap < 5 percent; reporting only
definitions.regret_uses: forced mean of the chosen architecture, not the separate Auto wall time

historical.note: Historical evidence. These files were not rerun and were not used to change the classifier.

phase3a_original.label: phase3a_original_development_matrix
phase3a_original.note: The original matrix stores Auto wall time separately from forced Lightweight and Hybrid. The chosen strategy is the forced path whose mean is closer to that Auto window. Phase 3A reported zero misclassifications.
